trust_decision.summary: Which stored cookies get attached to an outgoing request is decided in ClientFilters.Cookies via CookieStorage.retrieve(); at the pinned commit BasicCookieStorage keys cookies by name only, so any cookie set by one origin is forwarded to every other origin the same client talks to.

landing_point.why: The advisory names BasicCookieStorage by name, and that class is the whole of the pinned implementation; an engineer reads it first.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: LocalCookie constructor, used by every CookieStorage implementation and serialized by callers
public API: CookieStorage.retrieve(uri) (signature change forces every implementation to take the request origin)
ClientFilters.Cookies() default storage (BasicCookieStorage -> InsecureCookieStorage; new scoped DefaultCookieStorage)
ClientFilters.Cookies(clock|timeSource, storage) HTTP client filter (sending, storing and expiry removal all take request.uri)
Http4kWebDriver.manage().addCookie (public WebDriver API writes the local jar)
Http4kWebDriver internal CookieStorage wired into ClientFilters.Cookies at Http4kWebDriver.kt:43

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Http4kWebDriver is a Selenium test double: its own tests require every stored cookie to be sent on any navigation (Http4kWebDriverTest.kt:143-153) and cookies added before navigating (Http4kWebDriverTest.kt:148-151), so a solver can call the jar a fake rather than a production security boundary.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Domain-attribute cookies must still be shared with subdomains (Domain=example.com from example.com reaching api.example.com), while a Domain naming a host the origin does not domain-match must be rejected; a fix that drops Domain breaks the legitimate subdomain case, and one that trusts the attribute keeps the cross-site leak. Relative/empty-host requests must also keep sharing cookies (ClientCookiesTest.kt:29-34).

O6_input_shapes: host-only cookie (no Domain attribute) versus Domain attribute, with and without a leading dot
Path attribute versus no Path (RFC 6265 default-path derived from the request path)
Secure flag: cookie only over https versus plain http origin
relative request URIs with an empty host (Uri.of("")) used by the pre-existing tests
the same cookie name stored from two different origins as independent entries

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Http4kWebDriver.manage().getCookies()/getCookieNamed return every cookie in the shared siteCookies map regardless of the page origin the driver is on
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a fake WebDriver for tests and its existing tests assert all cookies are returned; the fix only changed the private storage's retrieve signature, so a solver reads the shared jar as intended.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same class as the storage implementation but a different public API surface (WebDriver.Options) in another module from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Expiry cleanup removes cookies by name across every origin (storage.remove(name)), so an expired cookie at origin A deletes origin B's live cookie with the same name
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The published fix's own DefaultCookieStorageTest asserts remove deletes across all origins, and it is deletion rather than the CWE-200 read leak, so a solver treats it as intended.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point (one method below the vulnerable class)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a durable CookieStorage implementation (Redis/JDBC/S3) of the same public interface that re-loads cookies without the origin
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: http4k already ships a connect/storage/{redis,jdbc,s3} module family, so a persisted cookie jar is a natural sibling a maintainer would write.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second in-repo cookie jar (e.g. a server-side session jar for the app under test) implementing CookieStorage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the driver already keeps a private siteCookies jar and implements the interface anonymously; a second one for the fake server side is one class away.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a host/base-URI rewriting filter (SetHostFrom/SetBaseUriFrom) composed outside Cookies, so the jar scopes on the pre-rewrite placeholder host and cookies leak across all real hosts
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: both filters already live in this object and are composed with Cookies in the Cognito test fixture, so a maintainer could write that composition as a helper.

O9_family: information exposure - cross-origin cookie leakage from missing RFC 6265 domain/path/scheme scoping (CWE-200)

O10_build.project_tests: JUnit 5 + hamkrest unit tests in core/core (ClientCookiesTest.kt, LocalCookieTest.kt) and JUnit tests in core/testing/webdriver (Http4kWebDriverTest.kt:123-168); all in-process, no network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep BasicCookieStorage and filter by host inside ClientFilters.Cookies only, leaving the storage class and the webdriver jar globally shared.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix diff also edits test fixtures (connect/amazon/cognito CognitoContract.kt, core/security/oauth setup.kt) purely for the changed retrieve signature; no issue seen outside this advisory's cookie-scoping protection.
